Paragraph:
Translation: Even kings like Janaka and others attained the perfectional stage by performance of prescribed duties. Therefore, just for the sake of educating the people in general, you should perform your work.

Purport (Excerpt): Kings like Janaka and others were all self-realized souls... Nonetheless they performed all prescribed activities just to set examples for the people in general... Although one who is situated in Krsna consciousness may not have any interest in the world, he still works to teach the public how to live and how to act.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Questioning why a spiritually advanced person should continue working in society when they no longer need personal gains.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna cites King Janaka as an example of a self-realized leader who continued doing his prescribed duties to educate and guide society (lokasangraha).
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna sees that engaging in his role is essential to model responsible behavior for others.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Leadership by Example: Demonstrating proper conduct through direct personal behavior
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Social Stewardship: Acting with care for the psychological and moral structure of the community
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Role Modeling: Guiding others through disciplined, value-aligned living

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Lokasangraha (Working for the guidance, cohesion, and welfare of society)
Janakadayah (Historical exemplars like King Janaka who combined enlightenment with social duty)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Enlightened kings like Janaka attained perfection while carrying out their societal roles. Krishna urges Arjuna to perform his duty not for personal gain, but to guide, inspire, and maintain harmony within human society (lokasangraha).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Leaders and role models carry a psychological responsibility toward their communities. Demonstrating disciplined, principled behavior provides stability and clear direction for those who look up to them.
